name: jsdotnet-project-guidelines
description: Eight skills for working with the jsdotnet-coding-guidelines MCP server and JSdotNet Copilot setup: ADRs, architecture patterns, coding standards, documented decisions, Azure Foundry model catalog selection, and server smoke-testing.

skills.title: JSdotNet Coding Guidelines MCP
skills.description: Reference guide for the jsdotnet-coding-guidelines MCP server: tool reference, valid categories, common tags, and example workflows for ADRs, architecture patterns, and coding standards.

skills.title: Project Architecture Gap Analysis
skills.description: Analyze your .NET project structure against established guidelines. Identify missing layers, conventions, and create an improvement plan.

skills.title: Code Review Against Guidelines
skills.description: Validate code changes against architectural patterns, coding standards, and documented decisions. Review PRs and designs for compliance.

skills.title: Decision Validation
skills.description: Validate architectural and technical decisions before implementation. Ensure decisions align with guidelines and have proper rationale.

skills.title: Migration Planning
skills.description: Plan and execute incremental refactoring to align code with guidelines. Break into phases, manage dependencies, and track progress.

skills.title: Guidelines Feedback Loop
skills.description: Analyze MCP usage logs, identify improvement opportunities, and propose new ADRs or documentation enhancements as GitHub issues.

skills.title: Copilot Model Selection
skills.description: Choose Azure Foundry model catalog/deployment entries for Copilot sessions, configure token limits, and avoid Claude 5 provider failures caused by deprecated sampling parameters.

skills.title: Test Coding Guidelines Server
skills.description: Smoke-test the jsdotnet-coding-guidelines MCP server to verify it is connected, returning expected content, and that all tools work end-to-end.
